name: Zumpo/Player row
description: One player in the room list. The list is always sorted by score. Host shows the crown (it passes on when the host leaves); You marks the viewer. Status says what the player is doing right now, never a generic “Connected”. Highlight: the player whose turn it is. Scored: guessed this turn. Away: dropped, seat held for 30 s. Show score: off in a game with no score (Hush). Wrap: a long status wraps to a second line instead of ending in an ellipsis, in a game’s final standings.
